title: work-on-the-problem-outlined-in-issues-md
description: work on the problem outlined in issues.md

researchNotes: Issue scope is in pi/extensions/changeflow/issues.md: stale queued phase prompts can cause repeated high-level plan submissions/reopened Plannotator reviews; missing submit-tool state guards; optional duplicate review protection and Plannotator review-status reconciliation.

Changeflow implementation is a single TypeScript extension at pi/extensions/changeflow/index.ts. Workflow state is persisted to .pi/changeflow/<id>/workflow.json and session entries via pi.appendEntry('changeflow-state'). Transitions are handled by an internal transitions map derived from machineDefinition.

queuePhaseContinuation currently builds a follow-up containing `Continue the Changeflow workflow in its current phase.\n\n${phasePrompt(activeWorkflow)}` (index.ts:197-201). This is the stale snapshot source; before_agent_start already injects fresh phasePrompt(activeWorkflow) context (index.ts:501-510), so queued follow-ups can be reduced to a minimal continuation message.

changeflow_submit_high_level_plan currently only checks activeWorkflow, writes high-level-plan.md, saves highLevelPlanPath, and calls requestPlanReview (index.ts:455-470). It has no state guard, so a stale prompt can call it while state is high_level_user_review and open another Plannotator review.

changeflow_submit_detailed_plan similarly only checks activeWorkflow before writing detailed-plan.md and transitioning with DETAILED_PLAN_SUBMITTED (index.ts:475-488). It should fail when not in detailed_planning so stale/invalid calls cannot mutate artifacts or transition unexpectedly.

Plannotator event API supports action 'review-status' on channel plannotator:request. The response type is pending | completed with review result | missing; statuses are stored in ~/.pi/plannotator-review-status.json. Source: /home/taylorl/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@plannotator/pi-extension/plannotator-events.ts lines 20-75, 151-179, 214-220.

Changeflow currently maps review IDs in memory and persists them in activeWorkflow.context.reviews when requestPlanReview succeeds (index.ts:319-327). The review-result listener can correlate persisted reviews after reload (index.ts:536-544), but there is no session_start/before_agent_start reconciliation for a review completed while Changeflow missed the live event.
Validation baseline: `cd pi/extensions/changeflow && npm run check` passes. git status only shows the current Changeflow artifact directory untracked, no source-code changes from this research phase.
decisions: Research complete: identified relevant Changeflow code paths, current missing guards, stale queued prompt source, Plannotator review-status API, and validation baseline.
User approved the detailed plan with 'go'.
Execution will run sequentially in the main Pi session because the approved plan primarily edits one TypeScript file, with optional README documentation after code changes and validation last.

Implemented minimal queued continuations, submission state guards, duplicate pending review protection, Plannotator review-status reconciliation, shared review-result handling, and README updates. Typecheck passes with `cd pi/extensions/changeflow && npm run check`.

QA complete: reviewed final diff, confirmed queued follow-ups no longer embed phasePrompt except fresh before_agent_start injection, verified README updates, ran `npm run check`, `npm run build`, and `git diff --check` successfully. Only source changes are index.ts and README.md plus workflow artifacts.
